sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: What the app has told the viewer, behind a bell that counts the unread: a list of notices, each with its tone, title, a line and when it came, the unread marked, with Mark all as read.

anatomy.bell: A ghost icon button with a bell, named by bell; with any unread, parts' Count (small, round, critical) over its top end.
anatomy.panel: A popover 320 wide aligned to the bell's end, unpadded: the head, then the list or the empty state.
anatomy.head: A row padded 12 across and 8 down over a border edge: the title at text.sm, and with any unread and onMarkAllRead, Mark all as read (ghost, extra small) at its end.
anatomy.list: No taller than 384, scrolling, padded 4: each notice a row 10 apart, padded 10 across and 8 down, rounded by radius-control.
anatomy.notice: A dot 8 across in its tone (neutral muted-foreground at 50 percent, good, warning, critical), then a column 2 apart: the title at text.sm (500 while unread), a line at text.xs in muted-foreground, and when at text.2xs in muted-foreground; while unread, on primary at 5 percent with a dot 8 across in primary at its end.
anatomy.empty: With no notices: a bell struck through, 20 square, over the empty words, at text.sm in muted-foreground, padded 32 down.

notices.does: Each notice: its id, title, line, time, tone and whether it is unread.

onOpen.does: Makes each notice a button the app opens and marks read.

onMarkAllRead.does: Shows Mark all as read while any is unread.

rest.means: The bell, with its count while any is unread.

open.means: The panel open under the bell.

unread.means: A notice not read yet: on a wash with a dot, its title at 500.

empty.means: Nothing in the inbox: the empty words.

hover.means: The pointer over a notice that is a button: washed.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a notice: the focus ring.

keyboard.does: Opens the inbox, or the notice with focus.
keyboard.when: the bell or a notice has focus

appText.title: Each notice's title.
appText.when: When each came, as the app writes it.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
